summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc reporting PDMR transactions — the grant of Performance Share Units (PSUs) under the company's Long-Term Incentive Plan to its CEO and Chief Commercial Officer. The PSUs have a zero exercise price, vest on 26 March 2029, and are subject to continued service and performance conditions. No consideration is paid, and the filing is a standard equity grant disclosure for insider transactions. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital returns, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change event. This is an ordinary current report with no special-situations significance.
